# Ground truth: simulated sweep of `philosophy_shelf.jpg`

Source: "Part of a bookshelf containing books about ancient philosophy (1).jpg", Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Hand-labelled from the full-resolution photo, left to right, main shelf only (the upper shelf shows only cut-off book bottoms and is excluded).

- 25 books: 15 with legible spines; 6 shelved backwards (page edges out); 2 mostly hidden behind neighbours (positions 3 and 7); 2 cut by the photo edge (1, 25; 25 shows only a partial word).
- Positions 15/16 and 23/24 are volumes I and II with identical titles: two books each, not one.
- No physical measurements exist for this photo, so spine dimensions and room figures are not scored here.
